## Disposition

**Problem 30004524 remains UNRESOLVED after approach 1 (1/5).** This draft adds a proof-only edition of accepted partial results, the complete independent mathematical audit and the complete authored source analysis. It supplies neither a general continuous PL extension selector nor a counterexample, adds no substantive approach and changes no queue file or turn count.

The question asks for a continuously chosen finite PL embedding of a triangle extending every prescribed finite PL boundary embedding into the plane. The report explicitly uses uniform/compact-open topology; the short primary statements leave mapping-space topology unstated. Arbitrary finite subdivisions and unrestricted output complexity remain allowed.

## Accepted mathematics and exact gap

The full written proofs establish contractibility of extension fibers by finite PL Alexander rescaling, continuous interpolation with varying image regions, local-to-global gluing, and equivalence of global selector existence with a local selector on a full uniform neighborhood of the inclusion. The zero-weight, support-boundary and parameterized ambient Schoenflies details are independently audited.

The convex-image subspace has a 1-Lipschitz selector. Shrinking hairpins obstruct every continuous radial-cone apex rule near the inclusion, and any exact selector requires unbounded triangulation complexity on every full uniform neighborhood. Neither obstruction proves nonexistence of an unrestricted selector.

The missing PL-valued local section must preserve the exact boundary map throughout a full uniform neighborhood containing arbitrarily subdivided boundaries and small steep features. It is neither constructed nor disproved. The checked topological, PL homotopy-density, local-contractibility and conformal results do not supply it as stated. The source audit also addresses Yagasaki's genuine PL local extensions into a fixed ambient boundary and explains why that setting does not handle freely moving plane curves.

## Evidence and editorial boundary

Nine prose/metadata files are added only under `unsolved_math_prioritization/attempts/30004524/`. The complete mathematical report, mathematical audit, source reasoning and substantive acceptance boundaries are retained. Edition notices and PROVENANCE.md identify narrow inventory-only edits: omitted-file tables, local paths, excluded-artifact hashes, executable commands and original packet bookkeeping are removed or reconciled.

The written hairpin coordinates, determinant and explicit collision proof remain unchanged. The original audit's four matched fixture rows, 194 unshifted cases and 150 translated-apex cases remain clearly labeled historical supplementary verification. Their programs, fixtures and standalone outputs are excluded; they were not rerun during packaging and are not executable from this edition. No omitted program or fixture has been converted into replacement prose. The analytical arguments, rather than finite sample counts, establish the universal partial results.

This addition includes no copied source PDFs, extracted source text, source images, datasets, private sources, private personal data or private coordination material. Sanitized public-source metadata retains scholarly titles, public URLs, raw public PDF sizes and hashes, inspection history and reported independent matches, without local paths or derived-source-text hashes.

## Sources and review limits

The primary statement is Michael Dobbins's Problem 14 in [OWR 30/2020, printed p. 1523](https://ems.press/content/serial-article-files/46867), also in [Rote's 2020 public problem list, p. 4](https://page.mi.fu-berlin.de/rote/Kram/Problems-Discrete-Geometry-2020.pdf). The full authored source audit preserves the checks of [Yagasaki](https://arxiv.org/abs/math/0010222), [Gauld](https://www.numdam.org/item/CM_1976__32_1_3_0/) and [Dobbins](https://jep.centre-mersenne.org/articles/10.5802/jep.171/).

These are historical inspection records, not fresh source retrieval or a comprehensive present-day literature review. Acceptance is independent AI-assisted mathematical review, not human peer review, journal acceptance or formal proof-assistant verification. No required mathematical correction was identified.

## Integrity and repository scope

The edition manifest identifies the eight other payload files and lists itself without a self-hash. Local exact-allowlist, UTF-8/JSON, mathematical-core identity, link, excluded-material, addition-only patch and clean-replay checks passed. They establish packaging identity, not mathematical truth or reproduction of the omitted computations.

No QUEUE.md or unrelated file is included. No CI-passing claim is made. Draft only; no merge, release or outside outreach.
title: Add audited PL extension partial results (30004524)
